verdict.rationale: Gusto's API exposes payroll data (GET .../payrolls, off-cycle payroll creation) and a contractor payment preview endpoint (POST .../contractor_payment_groups/preview) that validates inputs and surfaces submission blockers, and the Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server lets AI agents interact directly with the API — giving an ai-native agent the building blocks to fetch/preview a run programmatically. However, there is no documented 'payroll preview' endpoint for regular employee payrolls (only for contractors) and no evidence of anomaly-detection or a structured pre-approval review/flagging mechanism for regular payroll runs. missing for 10: a dedicated regular-payroll preview/dry-run API, documented anomaly/exception surfacing logic, and an approval-gate workflow tied to agent-detected anomalies.
